typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsTRADEKEYWORDSWDEALID_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SWDEAL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD
fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD derive({Copy of SWDEAL_ID} = SWDEAL_ID,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string,
		Trade_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		KEYWORD_VALUE = {Copy of SWDEAL_ID},
		Trade_ID = {Copy of TRADE_ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsTRADEKEYWORDSWDEALID_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsTRADEKEYWORDSWDEALID
